description: 埃文斯弃兵 C51 — 打开斜线，Ba3象占长对角线攻f8

intro.popup_en: Line Control, Lesson 3: Open a diagonal for the bishop. The key move Ba3 controls the long a3-f8 diagonal.
intro.popup:
线路控制第3课
打开斜线，象控对角线
本局核心：Ba3
控制a3-f8长对角线！

outro.popup_en: The bishop on a3 controls the a3-f8 diagonal and points toward Black's king. Diagonal pressure can be subtle, but it can create serious threats.
outro.popup:
斜线控制精华
Ba3象控a3-f8
直逼黑王位
斜线威胁往往更加隐蔽致命！

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game, claims central space, and opens diagonals for White's pieces.
moves.popup:
e4开局
占中心，开斜线
白方主动争取空间

moves.popup_en: ...e5 mirrors White's central advance. The e-file is blocked as the Italian Game begins.
moves.popup:
e5对称应对
双方封闭e线
意大利开局进入

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops, attacks e5, and adds pressure to the center.
moves.popup:
Nf3发展
攻击e5，施压

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops and protects e5.
moves.popup:
Nc6保护e5
黑方标准应对

moves.popup_en: Bc4! The Italian bishop targets f7. The Evans Gambit is about to begin.
moves.popup:
Bc4！意大利象
瞄准f7
埃文斯弃兵即将上演

moves.popup_en: ...Bc5 develops to an active diagonal.
moves.popup:
Bc5发展
黑方也占主动位置

moves.popup_en: b4! The Evans Gambit. White sacrifices the b-pawn for time and control of the diagonals, one of the most popular attacking openings of the 19th century.
moves.popup:
b4！埃文斯弃兵
白方牺牲b4兵
换取速度和斜线控制
这是19世纪最流行的攻击开局

moves.popup_en: ...Bxb4 accepts the gambit. White can chase the bishop with c3 and gain tempi.
moves.popup:
黑方接受弃兵
Bxb4吃兵
但白方c3将追象，获得节奏

moves.popup_en: c3! White attacks the bishop and prepares d4. White will gain time and seize the central initiative.
moves.popup:
c3！追击b4象
同时为d4做准备
白方将在速度上超越黑方

moves.popup_en: ...Bc5 retreats to safety, but Black has spent a move on the bishop. White is ready to play d4 and take the initiative.
moves.popup:
Bc5象撤回c5
黑方保住象，但已浪费一步
白方下一步d4，中心主动权在握

moves.popup_en: d4! White opens the center quickly, attacks e5, and threatens the bishop on a5. White has gained two tempi for development.
moves.popup:
d4！白方快速打开中心
攻击e5，同时威胁a5象
白方速度领先两步

moves.popup_en: ...exd4 exchanges in the center and opens the e-file. White can recapture and castle, bringing a rook to e1.
moves.popup:
exd4兑换
e线打开
白方下一步O-O，车将占e1

moves.popup_en: cxd4! White recaptures and restores the central pawn chain. White's center is strong and the initiative is secure.
moves.popup:
cxd4重提！
c3兵吃回d4
中心兵链恢复，白方无顾虑

moves.popup_en: ...Bb6 retreats. The bishop temporarily blocks the a3-f8 diagonal. White will clear the line through castling and a central advance.
moves.popup:
Bb6象撤到b6
注意：b6象暂时挡住a3-f8斜线
白方将通过易位+推进来清除障碍……

moves.popup_en: O-O secures White's king and activates the rook on f1. White has a lead in development.
moves.popup:
O-O王车易位
王走安全，车到f1参战
白方出子全面领先

moves.popup_en: ...d6 stabilizes Black's center and prepares development. The bishop on b6 still blocks the diagonal, but White can clear the way with e5.
moves.popup:
d6稳定中心
黑方防守，准备发展
b6象仍挡着斜线——等白方推e5打通

moves.popup_en: e5! White advances and attacks the pawn on d6. The central break also helps clear the diagonal for the bishop.
moves.popup:
e5！白方推兵进攻
直接攻击d6黑兵
中心推进，为斜线开路

moves.popup_en: ...dxe5 captures the pawn. The pawn leaves d6, beginning to clear the diagonal.
moves.popup:
dxe5黑方吃回
d6兵吃e5兵
d6格清空——斜线开始打通

moves.popup_en: dxe5! White recaptures with the d4-pawn. The a3-f8 diagonal is now mostly clear, with only e7 in the way.
moves.popup:
dxe5！白方重提
d4兵吃回e5
a3-f8斜线已大致清空！
只剩e7一格……

moves.popup_en: ...Nge7 reorganizes Black's pieces, but the knight now occupies the a3-f8 diagonal. How can White exploit the line?
moves.popup:
Nge7马撤到e7
黑方整理位置
注意e7马暂坐在a3-f8斜线上
白方象将如何突破？

moves.popup_en: Nc3! White develops quickly and builds central control in preparation for Ba3.
moves.popup:
Nc3快速发展！
白方出子抢先
中心控制，为Ba3蓄势

moves.popup_en: Black castles. The king reaches g8 and the rook reaches f8, while Ne7 still blocks the diagonal. White can now reveal the point of the plan.
moves.popup:
黑方王车易位
王到g8，车到f8
Ne7仍在斜线上……
Ba3将如何利用？

moves.popup_en: Ba3! The bishop occupies the a3-f8 diagonal and attacks the knight on e7. If the knight moves, Black's rook on f8 becomes exposed: one bishop move creates two related threats.
moves.popup:
Ba3！斜线控制精华
象占a3，锁定a3-f8长对角线
Ba3直接攻击e7马！
马若移开→f8车立即暴露
这就是斜线压制——一步棋，双重威胁！
